name: Eggless New York Cheesecake
steps: Heat oven to 160°C. Mix crushed biscuits and melted butter; press into the base of a lined 15 cm deep tin.
Beat softened cream cheese with sugar until smooth; gently mix yogurt, cream, cornstarch, vanilla and lemon without whipping air in.
Pour over the base and bake for 55–65 minutes until edges set but the centre gently wobbles; turn off the oven.
Cool with the oven door ajar for 30 minutes, then cool outside and refrigerate for 8 hours before unmoulding.
tips: Bring dairy to room temperature before mixing to avoid lumps; do not overbake the centre.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
